note: Lesson 7.5 connects outside sources to the CRM with n8n; the flows are shown as steps.

walk.title: Solve it: every enquiry into Kora's CRM, once
walk.sample: Portal email · website form · Instagram · WhatsApp · Paystack deposit

steps.say: Enquiries arrive from five places. We build one safe door into the CRM, connect every source to it, and watch it daily.
Build the upsert-enquiry sub-workflow once. It validates inputs, finds or creates the contact and deal, and logs every call with a private token.
show: Token scopes: contacts, deals, custom objects

steps.say: Connect the sources: the website form with a secret header, portal emails parsed from Gmail, Instagram from the growth desk, and WhatsApp with its signature checked.
When routing sets an owner, send the approved WhatsApp template, only if the person consented. Otherwise, an email from the agent.
Deposits through Paystack. Verify the signature, confirm the amount, then move the deal to legal and payment. Never mark it won: that needs the signed agreement.
Monitor it. Errors go to Telegram. Every morning at seven, portal emails received are compared with deals created, and any gap raises an alert.

walk.end: That's integration: one idempotent door, every source through it, and a daily check that nothing slipped through.
